text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Dantsu Flame got injured, I 
brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I really messed up... I'm sorry for making 
you worry.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm totally fine with just this 
much!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's true~. It doesn't hurt that much, so 
I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
We still have the rest of today's routine 
left, so let's get back to training!
choice_data_list: You have to rest for now.
If it's just a light jog...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate it just because it's a 
minor injury. Let's wait and see how you 
do before moving around.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That may be true, but...
choice_data_list:
If it gets worse, you'll have to take an 
even longer break.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... That makes sense. I guess I'll take 
it easy for a while, then.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be fine on my own from here on. 
You're busy as well, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Please don't worry about me! Once I've 
calmed down, I'll head over to the 
Trainer's Room!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's being as considerate as always, 
but... right now, I want to help her 
relax, even if just a little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something we can enjoy without moving our 
bodies or using our heads that much...
choice_data_list:
……How about we play shiritori or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wait, shiritori...?
choice_data_list: No, you wouldn't do that, right...
No, you wouldn't do that, would you...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, no, sounds good to me! Let's go 
with... apple, an apple!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I've made her worry about me again. For 
now, I should put everything else aside 
and focus entirely on supporting her.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yay~, thank you very much!
choice_data_list: Just make sure not to overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ow ow ow...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mmm, it is throbbing a little, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I am truly sorry... I really should just 
rest properly for now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the injury has worsened... 
She should probably rest quietly for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Phew~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, as long as we take it slow, it 
doesn't hurt!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, like this, we can keep training, 
right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, don't push yourself too hard!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Dantsu Flame overcame her injury 
and made a smooth comeback.
